representation_plans.learner_operation: Trace chambers, valves, vessels, and two serial loops.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: State every chamber, vessel, component, pressure, concentration, direction, and group label in reading order without supplying the requested result.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Relate wall, radius, pressure, resistance, flow, exchange, and skin heat.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: State every chamber, vessel, component, pressure, concentration, direction, and group label in reading order without supplying the requested result.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Separate liquid, formed elements, volume, and erythrocyte life cycle.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: State every chamber, vessel, component, pressure, concentration, direction, and group label in reading order without supplying the requested result.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Order injury, platelet plug, fibrin stabilization, containment, and resolution.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: State every chamber, vessel, component, pressure, concentration, direction, and group label in reading order without supplying the requested result.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Relate saturation, affinity, partial pressure, and local conditions.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: State curve axes, compared conditions, and marked points without ranking affinity.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Separate dissolved pressure from bound content and carbon-dioxide form.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: List oxygen pressure, saturation, hemoglobin, hematocrit, bicarbonate, and carbon dioxide values without interpreting them.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Track oxygen and carbon dioxide at tissues and lungs.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: State tissue and lung compartments and gas directions without supplying the answer.

demand_inventory.description: Trace right-heart pulmonary and left-heart systemic routes.
Name arteries away and veins toward the heart.
Match arteries, veins, capillaries, and endothelium to function.
Predict flow from pressure difference and resistance qualitatively.
Explain gas, solute, and heat exchange across capillary endothelium.
Relate cutaneous caliber to heat loss or conservation.
Distinguish plasma, cells, platelets, and whole blood.
Trace marrow production and aged-cell removal including spleen.
Relate circulating water/solute balance to plasma volume.
Order platelet adhesion/aggregation before fibrin stabilization.
Distinguish platelets, plasma reactions, and trapped erythrocytes.
Explain localization and later resolution as a bounded protective response.
Distinguish dissolved oxygen partial pressure from hemoglobin-bound content.
Relate hematocrit and hemoglobin amount to oxygen capacity.
Predict tissue oxygen unloading from local CO2/acidity.
Distinguish bicarbonate, carbamino, and dissolved carbon dioxide.

changed_task_decision_points.decision_point: Near classifies a pulmonary vessel by direction; changed maps ventricular state to arterial pressure.
Near predicts pressure-driven flow; changed uses vessel caliber for thermoregulation.
Near predicts a plasma-volume change; changed traces a cell life cycle.
Near predicts an early platelet defect; changed isolates later fibrin stabilization.
Near separates partial pressure from content; changed tracks both gases across pulmonary exchange.
